messages.subject: Installing RApache-- How to confirm that brew is working
parts:
RApacheInfo is working

That is, I have the following in my httpd.conf file:
<Location /RApacheInfo>
SetHandler r-info
</Location>

and I see the RApacheInfo window iwhen I browse to it from Firefox.

But the brew Handler does not seem to be working. If I have the
fillowing in my config file:
<Directory /var/www/brew>
SetHandler r-script
RHandler brew::brew
</Directory>

(where /var/www/brew is a va;lid directory) and attempt to access a
web page leaves the page never loads and the message at the bottom
says "Loading...". Forever. I downloaded and installed brew from the
brew website. I can run at least some of a brew script directly from
R so I think I have it installed OK. Does anyone know how I can
triubleshoot this?
